title: The U.A.E. Got A.I. Chips. Trump’s Inner Circle Got Crypto Riches.

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨四点半打电话给总统，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星的背面是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都使用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一个平底锅就能做好的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅以获取特惠，网址为nytimes.com斜杠subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日》播客。

sentences.en: A New York Times investigation into a series of major deals between the Trump administration, the United Arab Emirates, and the Trump family
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》对特朗普政府、阿拉伯联合酋长国和特朗普家族之间的一系列重大交易进行了调查

sentences.en: has revealed that the president and his inner circle are making millions of dollars from agreements that intersect with America's national security interests.
sentences.zh: 结果显示，总统及其核心圈子正从与美国国家安全利益交织的协议中赚取数百万美元。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Eric Lipton explains why these conflicts of interest are unlike anything we've seen before.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事埃里克·利普顿将解释为什么这些利益冲突与我们以往见过的任何情况都不同。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, September 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月24日，星期三。

sentences.en: Eric, welcome to the show.
sentences.zh: 埃里克，欢迎来到节目。

sentences.en: Hello, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 你好，瑞秋。

sentences.en: Eric, I feel like every time we've talked on the show, we've had you on to talk about some kind of conflict of interest
sentences.zh: 埃里克，我感觉每次我们在节目中交谈时，都是请你来聊聊某种利益冲突

sentences.en: that has to do with either the Trump family or the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 这种冲突要么与特朗普家族有关，要么与特朗普政府有关。

sentences.en: And you explain each time that what we are discussing is more significant or problematic than the last time we had you on the show or than another administration.
sentences.zh: 而且你每次都解释说，我们正在讨论的事比我们上次请你上节目时或比其他任何政府时期都更重大、更具问题性。

sentences.en: And here we are, I think it's been about four months since we had you on last time.
sentences.zh: 现在我们又见面了，我想距离我们上次邀请你大概过去了四个月。

sentences.en: And I think that once again, this is what you're going to tell me.
sentences.zh: 我想这一次，你依然会这么对我说。

sentences.en: Am I right?
sentences.zh: 我说的对吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: We're not talking about martinis at the Trump Hotel in D.C.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的不是华盛顿特区特朗普酒店的马提尼酒

sentences.en: or staying a couple of nights at the Trump Doral or people gathering at Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 也不是在多拉尔特朗普酒店住上几个晚上，或者人们聚集在海湖庄园。

sentences.en: These were things that were considered scandals during the first Trump administration by his critics.
sentences.zh: 在第一届特朗普政府时期，这些事情曾被他的批评者视为丑闻。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is an entirely different scale.
sentences.zh: 这是一个完全不同的量级。

sentences.en: What we're seeing here in these series of transactions is at a scale unlike anything I think I've seen as a reporter in actually four decades of doing my job.
sentences.zh: 我认为，我们在这里看到这一系列交易的规模，在我作为记者长达四十年的职业生涯中是从未见过的。

sentences.en: In terms of the national security implications and just the scale of dollars in play that are potentially enriching the president's family and the family of some of his advisors.
sentences.zh: 无论是就国家安全的影响而言，还是就潜在丰富总统及其部分顾问家族的巨额资金规模而言。

sentences.en: So, okay, I want to dig into specifically what we're talking about here.
sentences.zh: 所以，好吧，我想深入探讨我们具体在谈论什么。

sentences.en: You mentioned a series of transactions.
sentences.zh: 你提到了有一系列交易。

sentences.en: So tell us about the transactions.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲这些交易吧。

sentences.en: I mean, one of the deals directly financially benefits the president, his family, and some of his advisors.
sentences.zh: 我是说，其中一项交易直接让总统、他的家人以及他的一些顾问在财务上受益。

sentences.en: The second deal directly benefits the United Arab Emirates and its ambitions to become an AI superpower.
sentences.zh: 第二项交易则直接有利于阿拉伯联合酋长国及其成为人工智能超级大国的雄心。

sentences.en: So back in May, we have the first deal, which involves $2 billion of money from the United Arab Emirates going into a cryptocurrency company that was created by the Trump family
sentences.zh: 所以在5月份，我们迎来了第一笔交易，其中涉及来自阿拉伯联合酋长国的20亿美元资金，注入了一家由特朗普家族

sentences.en: and one of his advisors, Steve Whitcoff.
sentences.zh: 以及他的顾问之一史蒂夫·威特科夫创建的加密货币公司。

sentences.en: That happens in early May.
sentences.zh: 这发生在5月上旬。

sentences.en: Several weeks later, there's a separate transaction where the United States agrees to give the UAE access to some of the most advanced artificial intelligence chips
sentences.zh: 几周后，出现了另一笔独立的交易，美国同意向阿联酋提供一些最先进的人工智能芯片的访问权限

sentences.en: that are designed in the United States.
sentences.zh: 这些芯片是在美国设计制造的。

sentences.en: These are the crown jewels of American technology and it agrees to allow them to have hundreds of thousands of these chips exported to the United Arab Emirates.
sentences.zh: 这些是美国技术的皇冠上的明珠，美国同意允许将数十万枚此类芯片出口到阿拉伯联合酋长国。

sentences.en: So these two deals happen.
sentences.zh: 这两笔交易就这样发生了。

sentences.en: You know, my colleagues and I are watching this and we're like, wow, wait a minute.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我和同事们在关注这件事时，都在想，哇，等一下。

sentences.en: What just happened here?
sentences.zh: 这里究竟发生了什么？

sentences.en: How did these two deals come about?
sentences.zh: 这两笔交易是如何达成的？

sentences.en: And so we launched on an investigation that involved a team of reporters, including from San Francisco, from New York, Washington, Taiwan, and London.
sentences.zh: 于是我们展开了一项调查，团队包括来自旧金山、纽约、华盛顿、台湾和伦敦的记者。

sentences.en: I just want to make sure I understand why this would catch your eye in the first place.
sentences.zh: 我只想弄清楚为什么这件事会首先引起你的注意。

sentences.en: You were obviously an investigative reporter.
sentences.zh: 你显然是一名调查记者。

sentences.en: Did you see these two deals and think, I wonder if there's a connection because the UAE transfers $2 billion to the Trump-Witkoff family crypto business,
sentences.zh: 你看到这两笔交易时，是否在想，我很好奇它们之间是否有联系，因为阿联酋向特朗普-威特科夫家族的加密货币业务转移了20亿美元，

sentences.en: and then the Trump administration turns around and hands over to the UAE hundreds of thousands of these super important chips.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普政府转过头来，就向阿联酋交出了几十万枚至关重要的芯片。

sentences.en: Like, is that what initially piqued your interest?
sentences.zh: 比如说，这就是最初激起你兴趣的原因吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Okay, so what did you find?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么你发现了什么？

sentences.en: Were the deals related?
sentences.zh: 这两笔交易有关联吗？

sentences.en: And how did they come about?
sentences.zh: 它们是如何达成的？

sentences.en: So as our team of reporters worked on this, what we found was there were more linkages between these two deals that were publicly known
sentences.zh: 随着我们的记者团队对此进行深入调查，我们发现这两笔交易之间的联系比公开披露的要多得多

sentences.en: or that had been disclosed by the White House or the United Arab Emirates.
sentences.zh: 或者说比白宫或阿拉伯联合酋长国所披露的要多。

sentences.en: For example, there's this one guy who's at the center of both of these transactions, and he goes by the name of Sheikh Tuk Noon.
sentences.zh: 例如，有一个人处于这两起交易的核心，他的名字叫谢赫·图克·努恩。

sentences.en: He's the national security chief of the United Arab Emirates.
sentences.zh: 他是阿拉伯联合酋长国的国家安全主管。

sentences.en: And he's this kind of somewhat mysterious figure who's constantly seen wearing sunglasses because he has an eye condition.
sentences.zh: 他是一个有点神秘的人物，由于眼睛有毛病，总是戴着太阳镜。

sentences.en: So even when he's inside, he's got these shades on, and it gives him a kind of an air of intrigue.
sentences.zh: 所以即使在室内他也戴着墨镜，这给他平添了一种神秘的气质。

sentences.en: And he's been an intermediary for presidents and foreign advisors for many years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他一直是各国总统和外国顾问之间的中间人。

sentences.en: But starting around 2023, he began to transition to becoming one of the leaders in deploying the UAE's massive bank of oil money to make strategic decisions
sentences.zh: 但大约从2023年开始，他开始转型，成为运用阿联酋庞大石油资金库来做出战略决策的领导人之一

sentences.en: about how to transform the United Arab Emirates, this super rich oil country, into becoming a place that could raise money from some other economic sector.
sentences.zh: 研究如何将阿拉伯联合酋长国这个超级富裕的产油国，转变为一个能够从其他经济领域筹集资金的地方。

sentences.en: And they concluded that the best place to go to make more money was to become a technology beacon in the world.
sentences.zh: 他们得出结论，赚钱的最佳途径是成为世界的技术灯塔。

sentences.en: Like a Silicon Valley of the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 就像中东的硅谷一样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They want to build one of the largest AI data centers outside of the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们想要在美国境外建立最大的AI数据中心之一。

sentences.en: But in order to transform their economy,
sentences.zh: 但为了转型他们的经济，

sentences.en: Tuk Noon needed something for the United States, and that was access to these AI chips made by companies like NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 图克·努恩需要从美国得到一样东西，那就是获取像英伟达这样的公司制造的AI芯片的权限。

sentences.en: And he went to the Biden administration and he basically said, give us your chips.
sentences.zh: 他去找了拜登政府，基本上对他们说，把你们的芯片给我们。

sentences.en: And initially, they were quite skeptical of that because they were concerned about, you know, what's he going to do with those chips?
sentences.zh: 起初，他们对此相当怀疑，因为他们担心，你知道的，他会用那些芯片做什么？

sentences.en: Like for security reasons?
sentences.zh: 出于安全原因吗？

sentences.en: Or what was the concern exactly?
sentences.zh: 或者说具体的顾虑是什么？

sentences.en: Their primary concern was that the United Arab Emirates has had long-time close ties with China.
sentences.zh: 他们主要的担忧是，阿拉伯联合酋长国长期以来与中国保持着密切的联系。

sentences.en: And not only that, but they even have done joint military exercises from China.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他们甚至还与中国进行过联合军事演习。

sentences.en: They also have a defense contracting firm that is building military equipment jointly with China.
sentences.zh: 他们还拥有一家与中国联合制造军事装备的国防承包商。

sentences.en: And at the time that they first came to the Biden administration, they had put a bunch of Chinese equipment into some of their data centers.
sentences.zh: 就在他们最初找拜登政府的时候，他们已经在自己的一些数据中心里安装了一堆中国设备。

sentences.en: And this is equipment that the United States is concerned potentially could be compromised and used by China to gain access to American technology.
sentences.zh: 美国担心这些设备可能会被攻破，并被中国用来获取美国的科技。

sentences.en: So the Biden administration is concerned that if we allow the United Arab Emirates to have these crown jewels, some of the most important
sentences.zh: 因此，拜登政府担心，如果我们允许阿拉伯联合酋长国拥有这些明珠，即某些最重要的

sentences.en: technological inventions of modern times, are they potentially going to be sharing that technology with China in a way that could hurt the United States national security?
sentences.zh: 现代科技发明，他们是否可能会以损害美国国家安全的方式与中国分享这些技术？

sentences.en: That was a concern that the Biden administration had in particular.
sentences.zh: 这是拜登政府特别关心的问题。

sentences.en: Hurt the U.S.
sentences.zh: 损害美国

sentences.en: how exactly?
sentences.zh: 具体怎么损害？

sentences.en: Like what specifically are they worried would happen?
sentences.zh: 比方说他们具体担心会发生什么？

sentences.en: I mean, the United States is now in a race with China over the progress in artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，美国目前正在与中国进行一场关于人工智能发展的人工智能竞赛。

sentences.en: And it's not only an economic race, it's a military race because AI is already being applied to all kinds of weapons systems and particularly around drones
sentences.zh: 这不仅是一场经济竞赛，也是一场军事竞赛，因为人工智能已经被应用于各种武器系统，特别是无人机领域

sentences.en: that could be autonomously operated and armed and become autonomous killing machines.
sentences.zh: 这些无人机可以自主运行和武装，并成为自主杀戮机器。

sentences.en: And if China gets access to the most advanced chips that the United States is designing, they could accelerate their efforts to build a killer drone fleet
sentences.zh: 如果中国获得了美国正在设计的最先进芯片，他们可能会加速建立杀手无人机舰队的进程

sentences.en: that could threaten the United States.
sentences.zh: 这可能会对美国构成威胁。

sentences.en: So the stakes are obviously quite high.
sentences.zh: 所以很显然，利害关系非常重大。

sentences.en: The Biden administration has all of these concerns about what a deal for chips to the UAE could mean for American national security.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府对向阿联酋出售芯片的协议可能对美国国家安全意味着什么抱有所有这些担忧。

sentences.en: What happens after that?
sentences.zh: 那之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: I mean, the Biden administration ultimately reaches an agreement in which they talked to Sheikh Tuknun and they said, you know, you're going to have to remove
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，拜登政府最终达成了一项协议，他们与谢赫·图克努恩进行了交谈，并对他说，你知道的，你将不得不移除

sentences.en: some of this Chinese technology from your data centers and we will then agree to give you access to some of these chips.
sentences.zh: 你数据中心里的一些中国技术，然后我们才会同意让你获得其中一些芯片的权限。

sentences.en: But Tuknun is not satisfied.
sentences.zh: 但图克努恩并不满意。

sentences.en: Because he had seen Biden taking this very hard line, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 因为听起来，他看到拜登采取了这种非常强硬的立场。

sentences.en: They were quite frustrated that the Biden people were being too conservative, they were too nervous, they were nervous Nellies, that they were holding back the ambitions
sentences.zh: 他们对拜登的人过于保守、过于紧张、像惊弓之鸟一样、在阻碍阿联酋的雄心壮志感到相当沮丧

sentences.en: of the United Arab Emirates.
sentences.zh: 阿联酋的宏伟蓝图。

sentences.en: And that was where things ended and then Biden leaves office.
sentences.zh: 事情就在这里陷入僵局，然后拜登离任了。

sentences.en: But Tuknun wants more chips, he wants more powerful chips, and that's when Trump comes in.
sentences.zh: 但图克努恩想要更多芯片，他想要更强大的芯片，就在这时特朗普上台了。

sentences.en: And Tuknun, very smart guy, he sees an opportunity here to get what he couldn't get during the Biden era.
sentences.zh: 而图克努恩是个非常聪明的人，他在这里看到了一个机会，可以得到他在拜登时代得不到的东西。

sentences.en: And what do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: Like, what specifically does he see as an opportunity?
sentences.zh: 也就是说，他具体把什么看作是一个机会？

sentences.en: Well, Trump, the dealmaker that he is, puts in some senior advisors who are dealmakers themselves.
sentences.zh: 嗯，特朗普作为一名交易高手，安插了一些本身就是交易高手的资深顾问。

sentences.en: He puts in Steve Whitcoff, a real estate buddy of his from New York City, and suddenly Whitcoff is the Middle East envoy.
sentences.zh: 他安插了史蒂夫·威特科夫，他来自纽约市的房地产老友，突然之间威特科夫成了中东特使。

sentences.en: And then he separately puts in, as his AI advisor in the White House,
sentences.zh: 然后他另外安插了白宫人工智能顾问，

sentences.en: David Sachs, a venture capitalist from Silicon Valley, who comes from the world that thinks that the United States is best if it exports as many chips as possible around the world.
sentences.zh: 大卫·萨克斯，一个来自硅谷的风险投资家，他来自那种认为美国最好在世界各地尽可能多出口芯片的阵营。

sentences.en: And both of these guys become critical players in Tuknun's strategy to get what he wants.
sentences.zh: 这两个人都成为了图克努恩实现其目标的战略中的关键人物。

sentences.en: And so the new administration is starting, and Tuknun gets the work.
sentences.zh: 新政府开始运作了，图克努恩也开始行动了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏“连线”，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，我也喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天都创作

sentences.en: Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 拼字蜜蜂和字谜拼字游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色彩联觉的病症。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像刚才你听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com斜杠games即可开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So Eric, tell us about how
sentences.zh: 所以，埃里克，跟我们讲讲

sentences.en: Tuknun actually gets to work.
sentences.zh: 图克努恩实际上是如何开始行动的。

sentences.en: What does he do first?
sentences.zh: 他首先做了什么？

sentences.en: Tuknun first makes a visit to the United States in March, in which he comes here and he's treated like he is a major global player.
sentences.zh: 图克努恩首先在3月份访问了美国，他来到这里，受到了对待全球主要大人物般的礼遇。

sentences.en: He has private meetings with the head of the CIA, with the Treasury Secretary, the Commerce Secretary, with CEOs,
sentences.zh: 他与中情局局长、财政部长、商务部长以及首席执行官们进行了私人会晤

sentences.en: Jeff Bezos.
sentences.zh: 杰夫·贝佐斯。

sentences.en: He gets an audience with some very important people, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来他会见了许多非常重要的人物。

sentences.en: I mean, he was starting to get that kind of access during Biden, but this visit in March was unlike anything he'd had before.
